## Activity

During February 2019, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 66 captures. Activity was completed through the scheduled site sessions, which ran as planned apart from routine leave. The overall level of capture activity was monitored through the month and reported for operational review.

## Image quality

Of the 66 captures, 7 were ungradable. This represented an ungradable rate of 10.6 per cent. The ungradable images were identified during the grading process and excluded from the results available for clinical assessment. Image quality remained subject to routine review as part of site operations.

## Grading

Grading identified 2 referable results. These results were recorded for the appropriate follow-up process. The median lag between capture and grading was 6 days. This measure provides an overview of the time taken for images to progress through grading during February 2019. Overall, the site maintained planned activity, with the reported image-quality and grading outcomes documented for operational monitoring.
